description: Fallback for whatever still fails from the runner after FEAT-002, plus docs. No proxies, mirrors, scrapers or keys: sources stay in the registry and stay `failed`, but the per-source `error` becomes short and specific via errorSummary(err, { onRunner }) ('blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare', 'HTTP 404 (3 attempts)'), still <= 120 chars for src/schema.js and the UI health list. README gets the measured list of still-blocked sources, the new YouTube/arXiv notes, the probe:runner command and the probe dispatch input. A results file records before/after. Plan items 9-11, decision D5. Depends on FEAT-002's findings (the still-failing list).
steps: Read context.json, runner-fix-plan.md (items 9-11, D5) and FEAT-002.json findings (the list of sources still failing from the runner and their `detail` strings). git pull --rebase origin main.

src/http.js: export errorSummary(err, { onRunner = false } = {}): if err instanceof HttpError && err.status === 403 && /cloudflare/i.test(err.detail?.server ?? '') -> onRunner ? 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare' : 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare'; else if err instanceof HttpError && Number.isInteger(err.attempts) && err.attempts > 1 -> `HTTP ${err.status} (${err.attempts} attempts)`; else errorClass(err). Every returned string must be <= 120 chars and single-line. errorClass itself is unchanged (tests and the arXiv note pin it).

src/pipeline.js: run() passes onRunner: env?.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true' in the deps object given to runSource (the fixture tests pass env: {} so they stay off-runner); runSource reads `onRunner = false` from deps and sets result.error = errorSummary(err, { onRunner }) in its catch block (detail handling from FEAT-001 unchanged). scripts/probe-sources.mjs passes onRunner: process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true' to runSource. Do not touch app.js, sources.config.mjs or healthStatus semantics.

tests/http.test.js: errorSummary matrix: HttpError(403, url, undefined, { server: 'cloudflare' }) -> 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare' and, with { onRunner: true }, 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; HttpError(403) without detail -> 'HTTP 403'; HttpError(404) with attempts = 3 -> 'HTTP 404 (3 attempts)'; a TimeoutError -> 'timeout'; every output length <= 120. tests/pipeline.test.js: runFixture({ onlySourceIds: ['importai'], dryRun: true, env: { GITHUB_ACTIONS: 'true' }, overrides: <the cloudflare 403 override from FEAT-001> }) -> error 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; the same without env -> 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare'; the existing full-run test still sees reddit.error === 'HTTP 403' (fixture 403 has no server header).

README.md: (a) 'Known limits': replace the 12-source bullet with the measured post-FEAT-002 list of sources still blocked from GitHub-hosted runners (names + their new `error` strings), state that no proxy/mirror/key is used by design and that the health button counts them, and mention that the same feeds work from a home connection; drop the 'Possible fixes: ... Invidious/Piped RSS mirror' sentence. (b) Sources table: Media/YouTube note -> 'browser-like headers; 3 attempts (2 s / 8 s backoff); feed endpoint answers 404/500 intermittently'; Research/arXiv note -> 'RSS announcements; the cs.AI feed is empty between the ~00:00 UTC expiry and the ~04:00 UTC rebuild (and on weekends), so the API fallback (15 s timeout + one retry) carries it'. (c) 'Local commands': add `npm run probe:runner   # header-variant matrix for the hosts that block Actions runners`. (d) 'Deployment': add `gh workflow run refresh.yml -f probe=true   # also runs scripts/probe-runner.mjs and prints the matrix in the job log`. (e) 'Data files' meta.json bullet: add `detail` (failed sources only: response server/cf-ray/cf-mitigated/content-type/location headers and the first 300 chars of the body, <= 400 chars). (f) 'How it works' header line: request headers are browser-like except Reddit and the GitHub API, which get the Ahead UA.

Write .agents/tasks/ahead-build/runner-fix-results.md: baseline (03:42:54Z, 33/19/12) vs the FEAT-002 run vs the final run below, one row per the 12 baseline failures + arxiv-cs.AI with status/httpStatus/error/note/detail; the D3 decisions taken; the explicit list of what could only be confirmed on the runner; the Actions run ids used.

Local verification: npm test (0 fail). Commit by name: git add src/http.js src/pipeline.js scripts/probe-sources.mjs tests/http.test.js tests/pipeline.test.js README.md && git commit -m "fix: short specific error strings for runner-blocked sources; docs". (The .agents results file is committed by the finalize step, not here.)

RUNNER round-trip: git pull --rebase origin main; git push origin HEAD:main; gh run watch <id> --exit-status; git pull --rebase origin main. Confirm in data/meta.json: still-blocked Cloudflare sources show 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; still-failing YouTube sources show 'HTTP 404 (3 attempts)' / 'HTTP 500 (3 attempts)'; arxiv-cs.AI is not failed; okCount >= 33. Confirm the live copy: curl -s https://sudish007.github.io/ahead/data/meta.json (or Invoke-RestMethod) has a generatedAt later than the run start and the same strings. Paste the final ok/empty/failed counts and per-source rows into runner-fix-results.md and into this file's findings. Set status completed.
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes with 0 failures including the errorSummary matrix and the on-runner/off-runner pipeline cases; the full fixture run still reports reddit.error === 'HTTP 403'.
Every error string errorSummary can produce is <= 120 chars and single-line (validateMeta accepts the run output).

After the push, the Actions run succeeds and data/meta.json (and the live https://sudish007.github.io/ahead/data/meta.json) show the D5 strings on still-blocked sources, arxiv-cs.AI not failed, okCount >= 33.
README 'Known limits' names exactly the sources that still fail from the runner in the final run, with their error strings, and documents probe:runner, the probe dispatch input and meta.detail.
.agents/tasks/ahead-build/runner-fix-results.md contains the before/after table for the 12 baseline failures + arxiv-cs.AI and the run ids.
verification: git pull --rebase origin main && git push origin HEAD:main; gh run watch <id> --exit-status

git pull --rebase origin main; node -e "const m=require('./data/meta.json');console.log(m.generatedAt,m.okCount,m.emptyCount,m.failedCount);for(const [id,s] of Object.entries(m.sources)) if(s.status==='failed') console.log(id,s.httpStatus,JSON.stringify(s.error),s.error.length)"
findings:
CODE (commit d3fdfb8 on main, 6 files): src/http.js exports errorSummary(err, { onRunner = false } = {}): HttpError 403 with /cloudflare/i in err.detail.server -> 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare' (onRunner) / 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare'; HttpError with integer attempts > 1 -> `HTTP ${status} (${attempts} attempts)`; else errorClass(err) (unchanged). src/pipeline.js imports errorSummary instead of errorClass; run() computes onRunner = env?.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true' and passes it in the runSource deps; runSource destructures onRunner = false and sets result.error = errorSummary(err, { onRunner }) in its catch (detail handling unchanged). scripts/probe-sources.mjs passes onRunner: process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS === 'true'. app.js, sources.config.mjs, schema.js untouched; no proxy/mirror/scraper/key.

TESTS: tests/http.test.js new errorSummary matrix (cf 403 -> 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare' / with onRunner 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; 403 without detail -> 'HTTP 403'; 404 attempts 3 -> 'HTTP 404 (3 attempts)'; 500 attempts 3 -> 'HTTP 500 (3 attempts)'; 503 attempts 1 -> 'HTTP 503'; TimeoutError -> 'timeout'; TypeError -> 'network'; every output <= 120 chars single-line; Cloudflare match wins over attempts and is case-insensitive; errorClass(cf) still 'HTTP 403'). tests/pipeline.test.js: the importai Cloudflare-403 fixture test now expects 'blocked: 403 Cloudflare' (off-runner, env {}) with the warn line 'importai: blocked: 403 Cloudflare [detail]'; new test with env: { GITHUB_ACTIONS: 'true' } expects 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; the full fixture run still asserts reddit.error === 'HTTP 403' (fixture 403 has no server header). npm test: 183 tests, 183 pass, 0 fail.

README: How-it-works header line (browser-like headers except Reddit + GitHub API); Sources table arXiv note (cs.AI empty between ~00:00 UTC expiry and ~04:00 UTC rebuild, API fallback 15 s + one retry) and YouTube note (browser-like headers; 3 attempts 2 s / 8 s; 404/500 intermittent); Local commands `npm run probe:runner`; Deployment `gh workflow run refresh.yml -f probe=true`; Data files meta.json `detail` (failed only, server/cf-ray/cf-mitigated/content-type/location + first 300 body chars, <= 400); Known limits bullet rewritten with the measured list (6 Cloudflare sources 'blocked from GitHub runner: 403 Cloudflare'; 6 YouTube channels 'HTTP 404 (3 attempts)' / 'HTTP 500 (3 attempts)', ~1 of 6 gets through per run), no proxy/mirror/key by design, health button counts them, same feeds work from home; Invidious/Piped sentence dropped.
